input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Step 4b says to turn a fixed defect into a platform/ci lint, but no workflow runs platform/ci check_*.py generically; each new lint needs its own control-plane workflow line, and several such PRs (#14877, #14808, #14894, #14911) sit waiting on the owner. A lint added by a red-team run is therefore unrun by default.

Step 0 asks to fix every open entry first, but all five open entries were control-plane changes that already have open PRs waiting on the owner; the step could say to skip entries whose PR is already open.

Step 3 sends unfixed process problems to prompts/process/backlog/ in the same PR, but /prompts/ (other than runs/, derived/, drift/) is control plane in CODEOWNERS, so following it gates the whole PR on the owner.

deviations.why: Step 4b: a new workflow step should go in its own control-plane PR. Did not open one for check_flag_words.py because the four lint-wiring control-plane PRs already queued are stalled on owner approval, and a fifth adds queue noise without running sooner.
deviations.did: Added the lint and its unit test (test_repository_is_clean asserts the tree is clean), which main_health.py runs by glob, and wrote docs/reports/redteam-2026-11-12-flag-words.md proposing one PR step that runs every check_*.py.
deviations.result: Fix and guard landed; the guard runs when invoked or when platform/ci tests are discovered, not on every PR yet.

deviations.why: Step 3 says a process problem you could not fix goes in prompts/process/backlog/ in the same PR, but /prompts/ is in .github/CODEOWNERS, so that would hold this PR for owner approval.
deviations.result: PR stays outside the control plane.

notes: Campaigns: artificial-turf calc.mjs (8 mutants, 5 caught; 2 equivalent, 1 gap) and platform/ci/check_page_lists.py (8, 6 caught; 2 gaps). Gap tests added; rerun: catch_rate 0.786 -> 1.0 after fix. Real defect found by asking who else calls the engines: the MCP server passes agent JSON, and flag() mapped 'no'/'off' to true. Swept 64 identical copies; all 64 venture suites green (node --test *.test.mjs in each dir). Guard added: platform/ci/check_flag_words.py + test (first run on the unfixed tree: 64 offenders; on the fix: clean). Step 0: 5 open entries all control-plane, PRs already open (#14877, #14698, #14612) or needing an fps study (framerate); left as is. check_flag_words.py is picked up by platform/ci/main_health.py's check_*.py glob; no PR workflow runs it yet: docs/reports/redteam-2026-11-12-flag-words.md proposes one main_health step instead of a control-plane PR per lint. Local CI: run_workflow_locally --for-changes selected 10 workflows; every step that ran was ok; 3 build steps UNRUN (need a built _site/).

mutants.note: Preset base depth unpinned; new calc.test.mjs test checks every preset uses its type's comparison depth.

mutants.before: if (value === true || value === 'true' || value === '1' || value === 1) return true;
mutants.after: if (value === true || value === 'true' && value === '1' || value === 1) return true;
mutants.line_text: if (value === true || value === 'true' || value === '1' || value === 1) return true;
mutants.note: 'true' and '1' that skip the first line fall through to Boolean(value), which is true for any non-empty string other than 'false'/'0'; same result for every input.

real_defects.issue: flag(value) ended in `return Boolean(value)`, so any checkbox word not in its lists ('no', 'off', 'No', 'n') read as true. Reproduced through the MCP server (platform/agents/tools.mjs): artificial-turf calculateBid({lawnSqFt:600, sodDemo:'no', geotextile:'off', ...}) priced $175.50 of sod dump and fabric the caller turned off. Fixed in all 64 copies: word map plus throw on unknown; guard platform/ci/check_flag_words.py; turf test sends no/off/Yes/' on '/maybe.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: Senior engineer: two mutation triages, reproduce via MCP, sweep 64 files and run their suites, lint + tests, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
